description: Connect over SSH to the UTCS public Linux lab machines, picking one that is up and lightly loaded.
command.connectInCurrentWindow: Connect Current Window to UTCS Lab Machine...
config.title: UTCS Lab Machines
config.username: Your UTCS (CS department) username for signing in to the lab machines. You are asked for it the first time you connect.
config.domain: The domain appended to lab machine names, e.g. agate becomes agate.cs.utexas.edu.
config.statusUrl: The page listing lab machines and their status. When it cannot be reached, the machine list built into the editor is used.
